mapper.select: select sap.id, sap.abac_id, sap.resource_type, sap.action, sap.url_pattern, sap.effect, sa.expression from security_abac_permission sap left join security_abac sa on sa.id = sap.abac_id where sap.status = 1 AND sa.status = 1 AND sap.deleted = 0 AND sa.deleted = 0

select saf.id, saf.abac_id, saf.resource_type, saf.action, saf.url_pattern, saf.field_mode, saf.fields, sa.expression from security_abac_field saf left join security_abac sa on sa.id = saf.abac_id where saf.status = 1 and sa.status = 1 AND saf.deleted = 0 AND sa.deleted = 0
